verdict.rationale: Fellow advertises configurable, organization-wide retention policies, including zero-day retention. Its Super Admin API lets Enterprise-plan admins delete data across the workspace and erase third-party data in line with privacy regulations, which covers both scheduled retention and on-demand erasure. Missing for 10: detailed docs on configuring retention schedules (granularity, separate settings for transcripts vs. recordings), explicit confirmation that deletion is permanent/irrecoverable, a non-API admin UI for on-demand erasure, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
